subject: Customer priorities & buying timeline — recap and procurement next steps
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medsys.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@medsys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer priorities & buying timeline — recap and procurement next steps

Hi Laura / Tom — thanks again for the time this morning. I wanted to capture a short, shared recap and the concrete next steps so your procurement and legal teams have a clean handoff. I pulled the highlights directly from our conversation and from what Tom flagged during the call.

Top business outcomes you told us matter:
- Reduce inference cost per patient note while keeping sub-200ms p95 latency for triage workflows.
- Maintain a verifiable audit trail and data residency controls for PHI.
- Avoid re-architecting current on-prem pipelines — prefer a VPC-hosted/private deployment with customer-managed keys.

Primary risks you called out:
- Any solution that routes PHI outside of our VPC is a non-starter.
- Procurement needs SOC 2 evidence + a short exception path for our internal security checklist items.
- Executive sign-off is contingent on an explicit rollback/exit plan and predictable monthly spend.

Procurement path and timeline (as discussed):
1) Procurement questionnaire (attached) — you said procurement will return this by 6/20.
2) Security evidence review — we will provide SOC 2 report + architecture diagram by 6/17.
3) Contract redline round — target week of 6/21 for initial comments.
4) Exec approval window — Tom indicated decision target by 7/2 if materials align.

Immediate asks / next steps (owners):
- MedSys: complete attached questionnaire and send back to procurement@medsys.com + grace.oconnor@redwood.ai by 6/20 (Laura).
- Redwood: send SOC 2 pack, encrypted architecture diagram, and an initial cost/latency estimate for your 300k monthly tokens by 6/17 (Ben).
- Both: schedule procurement call to walk through outstanding questionnaire items — suggested slot Wed 6/23 10am PT (alternatives welcome).

I'll mark action items in the MAP and keep the DocuSign route ready once redlines settle. If anything below is off, correct me and I'll update.

Thanks — Grace
--
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: medsys-procurement-questionnaire-v1.pdf (stub), MVP-performance-estimates-quantized.csv (stub), mutual-action-plan-v2.xlsx (stub)
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medsys.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@medsys.com>, procurement@medsys.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Customer priorities & buying timeline — recap and procurement next steps

Grace — thanks for the clear recap, that matches our notes. A few clarifications:
- We will not accept any PHI egress to a public hosted tenant; our preference is Redwood Private in our VPC.
- SOC 2 + pen test summary is required. If you can surface the SOC 2 report by Thu (6/17) that helps our security review.
- On cost: we need a conservative monthly cap for procurement to evaluate. Can you provide a capped pricing scenario for Dedicated vs Private?

I'll get the questionnaire over to procurement and aim to have it back to you by 6/20. Wed 6/23 10am PT works for a joint procurement sync — I'll calendar invite.

Regards,
Laura Chen
VP, Digital Strategy | MedSys Health
laura.chen@medsys.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Customer priorities & buying timeline — prep for security pack

Adding a quick internal note after Laura's confirmation: action items for us before Thursday:
- Security pack: grab latest SOC 2 cert, summary pen test, and a one-page architecture diagram showing VPC private control plane. I have the SOC 2 PDF in our shared secure repo; will pull and redact customer-identifiers. (Owner: Ben)
- Cost scenarios: Rishi, can you run a Dedicated vs Private monthly cost estimate with a hard cap option (3 node pool baseline + burst) and an assumed 300k tokens / month workload? Need this by EOD Wed.
- MAP: I updated mutual-action-plan-v2.xlsx with procurement path and exec approval checkbox. Grace, I'll hand off updated MAP before the procurement call.

If we want to give them quantized perf numbers for the triage workflow, pull sequence distributions and I'll produce a conservative p95 estimate.

Ben
--
Ben Carter | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Subject: MEDSYS — procurement questionnaire and SOC 2 ETA

Hi procurement team — following up on our leadership discussion earlier, attaching the questionnaire Laura referenced and our MAP. Ben will upload the SOC 2 pack to the secure link below by tomorrow morning. Please confirm receipt and flag any immediate gaps so we can address them on 6/23 call.

Quick summary for procurement intake:
- Deployment model requested: Redwood Private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS and on-prem tunnel for data ingress.
- Expected monthly usage: ~300k tokens (triage NLP pipeline), target p95 latency <200ms.
- Key compliance needs: SOC 2 Type II, architecture diagram, data retention policy, incident contact.
- Contract needs: monthly spend cap option and a simple exit clause for 90 days.

Links and attachments: 
- MAP (updated): https://redwood-inference.sharepoint.com/:x:/r/Shared%20Documents/MAPs/MEDSYS-MAP-v2
